top_signals.title: Pakistan Rejects Costly LNG Cargo as Blackout Risk Deepens
top_signals.summary: Pakistan may have to extend rolling blackouts after it refused to pay three times the pre-war price for an LNG cargo, which was the only offer its latest emergency tender drew. The single cargo, offered by BP, was priced at $27 per million British thermal units, Bloomberg reported, citing unnamed trading sources. “The international LNG price is around $23.18 per MMBtu, whereas the bid received was $26.969 per MMBtu. The price was considered too high, so a fresh tender has been issued,” a senior Pakistan LNG Limited executive said, as…

top_signals.title: Apax Lines Up About €1 Billion Debt to Buy Gerresheimer Units
top_signals.summary: Bankers are lining up about €1 billion ($1.2 billion) of debt financing to back Apax Partners’s purchase of two businesses from packaging firm Gerresheimer AG.

top_signals.title: Nearly 1,000 business manager visa holders left Japan in first half of 2026
top_signals.summary: Under stricter requirements imposed since October, applicants must now have at least ¥30 million in capital, up from ¥5 million.
